name: agentic-coach
description: Coaches you on your own Claude Code usage: reads your session transcripts on your machine, shows where time and tokens went and which feature would have helped, as a daily recap, a weekly review with proposed changes that are applied only after your yes, follow-through on earlier advice, and a one-line nudge at the end of a costly turn. It runs on your machine, and nothing is sent anywhere unless you choose to publish your own coach page.
